issues.issue: What is the RAD's role and standard of review on appeal from the RPD?
issues.result_text: RAD conducts a hybrid appeal, independently assessing; either standard may apply pending appellate ruling.

issues.issue: Should the psychological report about the mother be admitted under IRPA s.110(4)?
issues.applicant_position: Submitted a psychological report dated May 20, 2015 as new evidence.
issues.result_text: Report concerns the mother, not the appellants, and was reasonably available before rejection; fails s.110(4).

issues.issue: Should an oral hearing be held?
issues.applicant_position: Requested an oral hearing; if RPD decision not set aside, referral back to RPD.
issues.result_text: No new evidence admitted, so no hearing is required; oral hearing application denied.

issues.issue: Did the RPD fail to apply the Gender Guidelines?
issues.applicant_position: Counsel argues RPD failed to apply the Gender Guidelines to the claim.
issues.result_text: Hearing recording shows the Gender Guidelines were applied; claimants had experienced counsel and ample time.

issues.issue: Does a viable internal flight alternative (IFA) exist in Nigeria?
issues.applicant_position: Mother fears Boko Haram nationwide; counsel said IFA was the sole issue, with no adverse credibility findings.
issues.respondent_position: Counsel made extensive submissions on Northern Nigerians relocating south; stated position not given.
issues.result_text: RAD finds a reasonable and viable IFA exists in Port Harcourt or Benin City; neither prong of Rasaratnam met.
